title: Document a codebase from the repository that fits the team
statement: As a change author, I can keep the Saga beside the code or in a companion repository, so that I can document a codebase without first changing its repository.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A companion Saga refuses a source checkout that does not match its declared repository.
A companion Saga resolves code links from the source checkout the author selects.
A companion Saga reports the source revision its documentation describes.
A companion comparison aligns documentation changes with the corresponding source-code change.
An author can document an existing codebase without creating a source-code change.
Moving a companion Saga into its source repository preserves its existing links.
